functions.name: pump
functions.control_flow_review: Reentry is rejected before queue work. One step per ordinary pump and FrameBudget token brackets coordinator work. NEW_UPDATE reads previous+backup, validates source and updates detached JSON; NEW prepares; PREPARING validates and freezes candidate; PREPARED rechecks guard; READING rechecks context/known bytes/update before-image and passes approval; PROMOTING/DISPOSING/PRUNING consume actual worker completion. Failed stages route through DISCARD before completion.

functions.name: finish

A prepared unapproved predecessor is cancelled at lifecycle barrier; preparation-only wait reports an earlier unapproved request instead of spinning. Completion pops FIFO and commits job receipt before callback; callback cannot pump the next job while pump_active. Immutable document graph is shared with separate receipt roots and copied identity.

functions.name: _prepare
functions.control_flow_review: Prepare parses serialized/preencoded JSON and verifies exact temporary bytes. Promotion rechecks required baseline, temporary and previous+backup bytes, create-only and terminal predecessor. Existing valid primary rotates to backup while old backup is held; rejected primary is quarantined. Failed promote/readback attempts rollback and reports its completeness; unknown/rejected output is preserved. Successful readback owns returned bytes/document before old backup-hold cleanup.

limits_explanation: This supplement closes static duties of these three files only. Atomic multi-file or power-loss recovery is not proved by sequential rename/readback.
